manual_verification.general_comment: Automated scheduling verification is recorded in Prompts 7 and 8. Manual verification has not yet been performed or confirmed, and branch merge readiness remains false while Prompt 9 is pending and Prompt 8 is blocked on repo-local pytest residue cleanup.

tests.name: Test 1.1 - Specific date with availability
tests.purpose: Confirm a typed specific date returns direct availability for that date before any widget-first redirection.

rows.action: Open the chat surface for a tenant with scheduling enabled.
rows.what_is_tested: Baseline setup for typed-date availability checks.

rows.action: Ask for availability on a concrete date that has available slots.
Confirm the reply references that requested date directly.
Confirm the user sees the available slots for that date in the reply or attached widget payload.
rows.what_is_tested: Availability payload for the requested specific date.

rows.action: Confirm the system does not prematurely ask for booking details.

tests.name: Test 1.2 - Specific date without availability
tests.purpose: Confirm a typed specific date with no availability returns a truthful assessment and alternatives.

rows.action: Ask for availability on a concrete date known to have no slots.
rows.what_is_tested: No-availability path for typed specific date.

rows.action: Confirm the system states that the requested date has no available slots.
Confirm the reply offers nearby dates, next availability, or a valid scheduling exploration path.
rows.what_is_tested: Recovery and alternative guidance after no availability.

rows.action: Confirm the flow remains scheduling-focused and does not jump into booking.
rows.what_is_tested: No premature booking after no-availability result.

tests.name: Test 2.1 - Broad range such as next week
tests.purpose: Confirm broad-range scheduling asks for narrowing rather than dumping too many results.

rows.action: Ask for availability using a broad-range phrase such as next week.
Confirm the system interprets the request as scheduling intent.
rows.what_is_tested: Scheduling intent detection for broad-range language.

rows.action: Confirm it either states that availability exists in that range or truthfully states none exists.
Confirm it asks the user to narrow by date or gives a focused next-step prompt instead of flooding the chat with many slots.

tests.name: Test 2.2 - Relative date and time window
tests.purpose: Confirm relative date and time-window concepts are resolved usefully.

rows.action: Ask for something like tomorrow afternoon.
rows.what_is_tested: Relative date and time-window request path.

rows.action: Confirm the system treats this as scheduling intent.
rows.what_is_tested: Intent detection for combined relative date and time window.

rows.action: Confirm the system resolves the request into a concrete day or day-plus-time-window behavior.
rows.what_is_tested: Backend resolution of relative date and time-window concepts.

rows.action: Confirm the reply returns filtered availability or asks one targeted clarification only if needed.
rows.what_is_tested: Low-friction response behavior for relative scheduling requests.

tests.name: Test 3.1 - Reserve request before slot selection
tests.purpose: Confirm reservation language without a selected slot stays in scheduling-first behavior.

rows.action: Ask to reserve or book an appointment without naming a slot.
Confirm the system does not immediately ask for name, phone, or email.
Confirm the reply stays focused on finding a valid appointment time first.
Confirm the system requests narrowing or returns scheduling options as appropriate.
rows.what_is_tested: Useful next-step behavior before slot selection.

categories.name: Category 4 - Slot Selection And Booking Handoff

tests.name: Test 4.1 - Slot click enters booking directly
tests.purpose: Confirm slot selection triggers direct booking handoff for MVP.

rows.action: Reach a state where a slot-list widget is shown.
Click a slot.
Confirm the selected slot is clearly reflected in the next response.
Confirm booking starts immediately with the first required booking field.
rows.what_is_tested: Direct booking handoff after slot selection.

rows.action: Confirm the user is able to change or back out from the selected slot path if needed.
rows.what_is_tested: Low-friction escape path while hold remains active.

tests.name: Test 5.1 - Selected slot becomes unavailable
tests.purpose: Confirm lost-slot behavior remains inside scheduling recovery.

rows.action: Simulate or reproduce a slot-unavailable path after slot selection.
Confirm the system clearly explains that the chosen slot is no longer available.
Confirm the reply offers replacement slots or refreshed availability.
Confirm the user is not forced to restart the whole conversation from scratch.

tests.name: Test 6.1 - Macedonian scheduling concepts
tests.purpose: Confirm scheduling-related concepts work under Macedonian tenant language context.

rows.action: Use a tenant configured for Macedonian.
rows.what_is_tested: Language-context precondition for Macedonian scheduling intent.

rows.action: Ask for availability using Macedonian scheduling concepts such as a weekday, time window, or relative period.
Confirm the system interprets the message as scheduling intent.
rows.what_is_tested: Intent detection under Macedonian language context.

rows.action: Confirm the returned behavior follows the same scheduling contract as the English flow.
rows.what_is_tested: Contract consistency across tenant language contexts.

tests.name: Test 6.2 - English scheduling concepts
tests.purpose: Confirm scheduling-related concepts work under English tenant language context.

rows.action: Use a tenant configured for English.
rows.what_is_tested: Language-context precondition for English scheduling intent.

rows.action: Ask for availability using English scheduling concepts such as Tuesday, afternoon, or next week.
Confirm the system interprets the message as scheduling intent.
rows.what_is_tested: Intent detection under English language context.

rows.action: Confirm the returned behavior follows the same scheduling contract as the non-English flow.

categories.name: Category 7 - No Regression In Non-Scheduling Chat

tests.name: Test 7.1 - Catalog and business overview still behave correctly
tests.purpose: Confirm scheduling extraction does not break non-scheduling flows.

rows.action: Ask for service list or business overview content.
Confirm the reply stays in the correct non-scheduling flow.
rows.what_is_tested: No regression in catalog/business overview routing.

rows.action: Confirm the system does not incorrectly inject scheduling behavior.
rows.what_is_tested: Scheduling extraction isolation from unrelated chat flows.
